briefs.title: The 3AM Warehouse
briefs.venue: Concrete warehouse, Berlin. One room, no windows, fog to the knees.
briefs.crowd: 400 people, six hours in. The floor is locked but starting to drift.
briefs.situation: You have the room. Now take them deeper without losing a single one. The previous DJ left you at 128 BPM and slightly too bright.

briefs.title: The Wedding, 10:15 PM
briefs.venue: Function hall. Parquet floor, fairy lights, an open bar that has been open a while.
briefs.crowd: 120 guests aged 8 to 80. Three generations, one floor.
briefs.situation: Dinner is cleared and the floor is half full. Nobody can be left standing at the edge. You need the grandmother and the groomsmen dancing to the same record.

briefs.title: Rooftop, Golden Hour
briefs.venue: Eighth-floor rooftop. Low sun, warm concrete, a city going orange.
briefs.crowd: 80 people arriving with first drinks. Nobody is dancing yet.
briefs.situation: Nobody should be dancing yet. Your job is the next four hours, not the next four minutes. Build a room people do not want to leave.

briefs.title: The Last 30 Minutes
briefs.venue: Small club, lights already coming up at the edges.
briefs.crowd: 40 people left. Every one of them chose to still be here.
briefs.situation: This is the closing set. No more peaks. Send them out into the morning feeling something they did not walk in with.

briefs.title: Main Stage, Peak
briefs.venue: Festival main stage. Full rig, CO2 jets, a horizon of people.
briefs.crowd: 15,000 people, phones already up, waiting to be detonated.
briefs.situation: This is your peak-time slot. Maximum energy, zero subtlety permitted. Every track must be legible to someone 200 metres back who is not a dance music fan.

briefs.title: The Basement, 1AM
briefs.venue: House party basement. One speaker clipping, low ceiling, condensation on the walls.
briefs.crowd: 45 people, sweaty, close friends and their friends.
briefs.situation: No booth, no monitors, someone is standing on the sofa. Everyone needs to know the words to something. Nostalgia is a weapon here, but cheap nostalgia will empty the room.

sets.read: The floor is ready for a hypnotic reset, craving deep, psychedelic textures over bright, peak-time energy to get properly lost in the fog.

tracks.title: Lockdown Party (DJ Sprinkles' Crossfaderama)
tracks.why: Immediately drop the BPM and shift the mood from bright to deep, intellectual house.
tracks.transition: Let the vocal fade out over the stripped-back percussive loop of the next track.

tracks.title: Sakadat
tracks.why: Establish a hypnotic, percussive groove that locks everyone into a shared, swaying rhythm.
tracks.transition: Blend the intricate hi-hats into the atmospheric, acidic wash of the incoming record.

tracks.title: Parola

tracks.transition: Loop the final arp, filtering it down into the rumbling kick of the next.

tracks.transition: Let the cavernous reverb wash out, leaving one delayed stab echoing into silence.

tracks.transition: Cut the bass and mix the new kick in clean for maximum emotional impact.

tracks.transition: Let the synth hook ride, using a long delay to deconstruct the final rhythm.

tracks.why: Monolithic riffs visible from orbit; zero interpretation needed.
tracks.transition: Flare synth outro segues into Promises' anthemic guitar.

tracks.title: Promises (David Guetta Remix)
tracks.why: Vocals anchor finale while remix keeps energy apocalyptic.
tracks.transition: Laser sweep climax across repeated chorus; freeze.

sets.read: Intimate late-night energy craving genuine sing-along moments without cliché nostalgia.

tracks.title: Daft Punk Is Playing at My House
tracks.why: Raw indie-dance intro, shout-along vocals.
tracks.transition: Overlap drum outro with next track's beat

tracks.title: Electric Feel
tracks.why: Builds groove, familiar psychedelic hooks.
tracks.transition: Fade synth outro into bassline intro

tracks.title: Heads Will Roll
tracks.why: Driving energy, crowd shouts chorus.
tracks.transition: Filtered bridge into beat drop

tracks.title: Banquet
tracks.why: Indie-disco anthem, guitar-fueled sing-along.
tracks.transition: Echo guitar riff into synth swell

tracks.title: Hey Ya!
tracks.why: Explosive sing-along peak energy.
tracks.transition: Cut to acapella intro tweak

tracks.title: We Found Love
tracks.why: Cathartic EMD finale, euphoric unity.
tracks.transition: Full track climax, end set

sets.read: The crowd is deep but fraying, pull them into a darker, slower pull without breaking stride.

tracks.title: Death of a Latin Lover
tracks.why: Cold wave pulse re-engages feet, dark synth pulls focus deeper.
tracks.transition: Loop the bassline to fuse with next intro.

tracks.title: Fused
tracks.why: Steel-toed groove locks the floor back into unity.
tracks.transition: Filter out to leave only static, then drop beat.

tracks.title: Someone That Loves Me
tracks.why: Human voice and soulful synth lift without lightening the mood.
tracks.transition: Fade vocal into reverb tail, cue next kick.

tracks.title: Incubation (Phase 3)
tracks.why: Hypnotic, rolling pressure, holds emotion in suspended motion.
tracks.transition: Loop the pulse, slow decay into next rhythm.

tracks.title: Why They Hide Their Bodies Under My Garage?
tracks.why: Raw, industrial tension, pushes edge without breaking the trance.
tracks.transition: End on final hit, let silence crackle before next drop.

sets.read: Generational bridge needed, warm bodies, not wallflowers. Joy is the only language.

tracks.title: Rock DJ
tracks.why: Irresistible funk bass pulls skeptics in, cheeky energy unites ages.
tracks.transition: Strip it back to cowbell, cue the next groove.

tracks.title: I Will Survive
tracks.why: Anthem of resilience everyone knows, matriarchs claim the floor.
tracks.transition: Fade vocals early, loop string stab into next beat.

tracks.title: Hey Ya!
tracks.why: Explosive joy, kids jump, elders grin, all move fast.
tracks.transition: Match energy with stomp-clap rhythm into next groove.

tracks.title: Don't Stop Me Now
tracks.why: Uplifting, theatrical, universally loved, pure momentum at peak joy.
tracks.transition: Ride Freddie’s final note into disco downbeat.

tracks.title: We Are Family
tracks.why: The bloodline anthem, hands link, generations sync, hearts open.
tracks.transition: Extend intro beat, layer crowd noise into lull.

tracks.title: At Last
tracks.why: Slow dance closer, love honored, grandmas sway with groomsmen.
tracks.transition: Let final note breathe, then speak: 'One more?'

sets.read: Warm glow, early chatter, drinks in hand, ease them in with soulful depth, not forced energy.

tracks.title: Maria También
tracks.why: Hypnotic groove, global vibe, lets the space breathe and connect.
tracks.transition: Fade out slowly, slide into Rhodes chords of next track.

tracks.title: Heartbeats
tracks.why: Familiar melody, intimate tension, draws listeners inward, not outward.
tracks.transition: Echo the final note, bring in soft disco pulse underneath.

tracks.title: You Know I'm No Good
tracks.why: Sinister swing, magnetic attitude, shifts mood from chill to charged.
tracks.transition: Extend drum break, pitch up slightly into next groove.

tracks.title: Inspector Norse
tracks.why: Uplifting, quirky disco, makes people glance up and smile.
tracks.transition: Loop the riff, layer in house beat, shift key up.

tracks.title: Can't Do Without You
tracks.why: Emotional peak, swirling build, pulls the crowd into unity.
tracks.transition: Fade vocals, isolate bassline, morph into techno pulse.

tracks.title: Glue
tracks.why: Euphoric release, arms-aloft moment, holds the night aloft.
tracks.transition: Let reverb fade, introduce ambient synth for next set.

sets.read: Forty souls at dawn, tired but wired, craving emotional truth over beats.

tracks.title: Atmosphere
tracks.why: Haunting grace to meet the morning’s quiet judgment.
tracks.transition: Fade into silence, then the next track’s pulse.

tracks.title: Avril 14th
tracks.why: Solo piano fragility to expose the raw nerve.
tracks.transition: Let the last note decay into ambient hum.

tracks.title: Jóga
tracks.why: Strings swell like dawn breaking over grief.
tracks.transition: Rise with the music into gentle forward motion.

tracks.title: To Build a Home
tracks.why: Piano and voice to make them feel found.
tracks.transition: Hold the final chord, then drop the next beat.

tracks.title: Parallel Jalebi
tracks.why: Warm, looping joy to reawaken soft steps.
tracks.transition: Layer in the rhythm, guide them toward light.

tracks.title: Says
tracks.why: Building hope with every synth wave to close.
tracks.transition: Let the echo fade as doors open to daylight.

sets.read: Crowd is primed for euphoria, big melodies, explosive drops, zero patience for buildup.

tracks.title: Animals
tracks.why: Instant recognition, raw energy, ignites the entire field.
tracks.transition: Cut silence into next drop for maximum impact.

tracks.title: Don't Stop the Party
tracks.why: Vocal hook unites crowd, relentless forward drive.
tracks.transition: Loop snare roll to launch into next anthem.

tracks.title: Wake Me Up
tracks.why: Folk-house fusion lifts mood, universal singalong moment.
tracks.transition: Pitch up vocal into next track's intro.

tracks.title: Summer
tracks.why: Nostalgic euphoria, sun-soaked energy for mass release.
tracks.transition: Echo the final chord into next build.

tracks.title: Clarity
tracks.why: Emotional vocal peak, crystal synths cut through air.
tracks.transition: Fade reverb into next beat's kick.

tracks.title: Don't You Worry Child
tracks.why: Cathartic closer, arms up, lights high, moment sealed.
tracks.transition: Hold final chord, then silence. Walk off.

sets.read: They’re drunk on memory but won’t admit it, gotta pull the past up by the roots.

tracks.title: Dancing On My Own
tracks.why: Heartbreak banger that everyone knows but won’t expect now.
tracks.transition: Cut the drop, hold silence, then click the next.

tracks.title: Hey Ya!
tracks.why: They’ll scream the chorus even if their voices crack.
tracks.transition: Let the ‘shake it’ echo, then slash into next beat.

tracks.title: Rill Rill
tracks.why: Cool bleed with haze, lets them sway, not just shout.
tracks.transition: Fade the ‘sha-la-la’ into a vinyl crackle.

tracks.title: Killing Me Softly
tracks.why: Lullaby with weight, pulls focus back to the floor.
tracks.transition: End on the last note, pause, then kick the bass.

tracks.title: Paper Planes
tracks.why: Gunshots and cash, knows no drunker truth than this.
tracks.transition: Loop the cash register, then drop the beat like glass.

tracks.title: All My Friends
tracks.why: Twelve minutes of growing up, make them hug and forget names.
tracks.transition: Let the piano fade into breath. Then, nothing.

sets.read: They are bright-fatigued, not tired; I hold the tempo and take away the top end until the low mids do the work.

tracks.title: Ganzfeld
tracks.why: Kills the brightness in one bar without dropping tempo
tracks.transition: Let its texture rot underneath the next kick

tracks.title: Parola
tracks.why: Pure hypnosis; the floor stops watching and starts sinking
tracks.transition: Ride the loop, swap kicks on the bar

tracks.title: Subzero
tracks.why: Reintroduces weight from below, not brightness from above
tracks.transition: Long blend, hold both hats for sixteen

tracks.title: Voiceprint
tracks.why: Adds a human ghost so the depth stops feeling clinical
tracks.transition: Filter its pads up as the next intro lands

tracks.title: Phantom
tracks.why: Dub-techno swing loosens hips that had locked rigid
tracks.transition: Cut the low, let reverb carry the gap

tracks.title: Waterfall
tracks.why: Ends deeper and harder. Going down was going forward
tracks.transition: Hand over at 130 with all top end still stripped

sets.read: The floor is half full because no generation wants to commit first; I play one record all three already love so they arrive together.

tracks.title: September
tracks.why: The single record no generation in this room refuses
tracks.transition: Straight cut on the horn stab, no gap

tracks.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered I'm Yours
tracks.why: Pulls the oldest guests in while the young stay moving
tracks.transition: Ride the outro clap into the next intro

tracks.title: Dancing Queen
tracks.why: The grandmothers now own the floor and everyone allows it
tracks.transition: Let the piano ring, drop straight in

tracks.title: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
tracks.why: Hands the room back to the middle generation without ejecting anyone
tracks.transition: Cut on the last chorus, no long tail

tracks.title: Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'
tracks.why: Raises tempo where nobody notices they are working harder
tracks.transition: Run the chant under the next four bars

tracks.title: Hey Ya!
tracks.why: Ends on the groomsmen without ever having lost the grandmother
tracks.transition: Leave them shouting; house lights, not another record

sets.read: Nobody should be dancing yet; I am building a room people refuse to leave at nine, not a floor that peaks at half seven.

tracks.title: White Gloves
tracks.why: Warm, wordless, asks nothing of anyone still finding a drink
tracks.transition: Let the guitar hang, fade under strings

tracks.title: Cherish the Day
tracks.why: First voice of the night; conversation gets quieter on its own
tracks.transition: Blend on the pad, no percussive landmark

tracks.title: Les Nuits
tracks.why: Introduces a pulse the room can ignore or accept
tracks.transition: Loop the break, raise the low end slowly

tracks.title: Water No Get Enemy
tracks.why: Live horns as the sun actually goes; the room looks up
tracks.transition: Long ride on the groove, no rush

tracks.title: Kiara
tracks.why: First record that could be danced to, offered not insisted
tracks.transition: Filter sweep into the piano intro

tracks.title: Rose Rouge
tracks.why: The night formally begins; two people start and it is enough
tracks.transition: Hand to peak-time DJ mid-loop, floor already warm

sets.read: Forty people chose to still be here; I owe them honesty, not another peak. Records that say goodbye out loud.

tracks.title: A New Error
tracks.why: Signals the descent without announcing that it is over
tracks.transition: Let the arp thin out to nothing

tracks.title: Blurred
tracks.why: Strings arrive; the room quietly understands what this is
tracks.transition: Hold the piano over the next intro

tracks.title: Angel Echoes
tracks.why: A human voice, chopped. The first real emotion of the hour
tracks.transition: Fade in on the vocal loop, no beat

tracks.title: Archangel
tracks.why: The lights are already up; this is the sound of that
tracks.transition: Drop the drums, keep the vocal in reverb

tracks.title: Immunity
tracks.why: Piano and breath. Nobody is dancing and nobody minds
tracks.transition: Let it end fully; give the room two seconds of silence

tracks.title: An Ending (Ascent)
tracks.why: Not a track, a door held open. They walk out through it
tracks.transition: No transition. House lights.

sets.read: Legibility is the entire job: every record must be recognised in four bars by someone who does not like dance music.

tracks.title: One More Time
tracks.why: Fifteen thousand people know bar one; nobody is excluded
tracks.transition: Ride the horns, slam the next kick on the drop

tracks.title: Levels
tracks.why: Phones go up on the Etta sample, exactly as intended
tracks.transition: Cut to the next intro on the last bar of the build

tracks.title: Don't You Worry Child
tracks.why: Buys a singalong, which is the only rest a peak set gets
tracks.transition: Hold the vocal a cappella over the next four bars

tracks.title: Kernkraft 400
tracks.why: Wordless, tempo jumps twelve BPM and nobody objects
tracks.transition: Straight cut, no blend, let the gap land

tracks.title: Sandstorm
tracks.why: The most legible record ever made from 200 metres back
tracks.transition: Loop the riser, hold it four bars too long

tracks.title: Firestarter
tracks.why: Ends hardest, on a guitar, so even the sceptics get it
tracks.transition: Kill it dead on the last stab. CO2. Done.

sets.read: One clipping speaker and no monitors: I need records that survive distortion and get shouted rather than danced to.

tracks.title: Bam Bam
tracks.why: Establishes immediately that tonight is not cheap nostalgia
tracks.transition: Let the dub delay wash into the next intro

tracks.title: Ms. Jackson
tracks.why: Everyone in this basement knows every word of verse one
tracks.transition: Ride the outro, drop new bass under it

tracks.title: Feel Good Inc.
tracks.why: The bassline is the only thing this speaker reproduces well
tracks.transition: Cut on the laugh, straight into the synth

tracks.title: Kids
tracks.why: Somebody is now standing on the sofa; that is correct
tracks.transition: Hold the arpeggio, bring the next kick underneath

tracks.title: Dance Yrself Clean
tracks.why: The quiet intro makes 45 people lean in, then detonates
tracks.transition: Let the drop run full; do not touch anything

tracks.title: Dancing On My Own
tracks.why: Ends on the only record everyone here will scream
tracks.transition: No mix out. Let it finish. Somebody will cry.
